theme_and_art_direction.name: The Clinical Brutalist (Dark Mode Editorial)
theme_and_art_direction.description: An Awwwards Site-of-the-Day level editorial dark mode. It mixes heavy brutalist typography with precise, clinical digital elements. Deep obsidian backgrounds, massive kinetic text, and surgical neon accents. It feels like an expensive, elite reference tool rather than a cheap PDF.

motion_and_interaction.smooth_scroll: MANDATORY: Wrap the entire app or main content in <ReactLenis root> for momentum scrolling.
motion_and_interaction.hero_reveal: Kinetic Typography: Text masked line-by-line reveal using framer-motion. Wrap each line of the H1 in an overflow-hidden div, and animate the inner text from translateY 100% to 0%.
motion_and_interaction.book_3d_parallax: Build a CSS 3D book using a wrapper with `perspective: 1200px`. Inside, use a `motion.div` with `transform-style: preserve-3d` connected to `useScroll` to map `scrollYProgress` to `rotateY` and `rotateX`. The book needs front cover, spine, back cover, and 3D page edges.
motion_and_interaction.scroll_reveals: Fade up and slightly scale in (0.95 to 1) for feature cards. Add subtle parallax to images using useScroll.
motion_and_interaction.button_hover: Scale up slightly (1.05), add a colored glow drop-shadow, and slide a hidden arrow icon into view.

layout_and_grids.spacing_system: Generous spacing. Use py-32 or py-48 for main sections. gap-12 to gap-16 in bento grids.
layout_and_grids.bento_features: Use the Tetris Grid mode. Mix col-span-4, col-span-8, row-span-2. Never use perfectly symmetric grids. Leave an empty grid cell for negative space.
layout_and_grids.manifesto_numbers: Use massive absolute positioned numbers (text-[25vw] text-white/5 font-black leading-none) floating behind the manifesto text.

components.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee. Very slow, font-mono, text-sm, border-y border-white/10, py-4. Content: bullet-separated names of medicines and trust signals.
components.cards: Flat matte backgrounds (bg-[#0C0C0C]) with 1px border (border-white/10). No soft shadows. On hover: slight border color change to accent_secondary (#00E5FF).
components.pricing_card: Elevated glassmorphism. backdrop-blur-2xl bg-white/5 border border-white/20. Glowing #FF3366 CTA button.
components.sticky_cta: Fixed bottom center floating pill. backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/20 px-8 py-4 rounded-full shadow-2xl z-50 flex items-center gap-4.

abstract_texture.description: Abstract medical tech texture. Use as a subtle overlay blending into dark backgrounds, or as the cover texture for the 3D book mockup.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: yarn add framer-motion @studio-freight/react-lenis react-fast-marquee @phosphor-icons/react clsx tailwind-merge lucide-react
Add 'Cabinet Grotesk', 'Manrope', and 'Space Mono' via Google Fonts or standard Web Font imports in index.css.
Implement the 3D Book Mockup purely in CSS with Framer Motion (NO Three.js needed to keep it lightweight). Use absolute positioning for the spine and pages with preserve-3d.
Ensure all text remains readable by applying WCAG AA standards. If using image backgrounds, use strong linear-gradient overlays.
Create the entire landing page as a single page application in App.js or split into components, but ensure Lenis is wrapping the content.
universal_guidelines: CRITICAL: Do not center-align paragraphs. Use optical alignment. Headings can be centered if it serves the layout, but left-aligned text is preferred for readability.
CRITICAL: Do not use generic gradient backgrounds. Stick to the solid Obsidian (#030303) and Surface (#0C0C0C) colors to maintain the high-end brutalist feel.
Every interactive element MUST have a data-testid attribute for testing.
Buttons must have distinct hover states with subtle animations.
DO NOT use a fully transparent header; apply backdrop-blur-xl and a semi-transparent background color (e.g., bg-black/60) to keep navigation readable.
